notes.title: August 24th Small Update Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that prevented determining if the level was cleared when closing the popup by pressing the spacebar while grabbing a doll.
When deleting the archive now, achievements and collection rack progress will be deleted together.
Fixed the text display bug for obtaining dolls in free mode.
Fix the issue of incomplete text display in the doll pop-up in English and Japanese.

notes.title: Game launch limited-time discount 20%!
notes.notes:
The game "Doll Grabber" will be officially released on August 23rd!
Game will have 20% off for one week at launch! Price will return to normal after a week!

notes.title: The game "Doll Grabber" is about to launch!
notes.notes:
My dear friends, after a long preparation period,
We are finally able to announce that "Doll Grabber" will be officially released on August 23rd!

This is a casual puzzle game that simulates a claw machine.
There are 30 cute dolls waiting for you to grab!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647736/e40ca53463678aff150d2ebfa3c7949cefcb8975.jpg[/img]

After finishing the game, you can experience various exquisite character illustrations as a reward!
In the DLC version, you can still find numerous character animations and clothing differences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647736/77c315232a96748ad2487badd55cc9a3fb0e6b54.jpg[/img]

Now each character has an independent short story,
And we are very happy to announce that this game also adds Japanese voiceovers for all characters,
You can hear the voices of various girls, with full voice-overs for all differences and animations!

Now you can experience the realistic performance of the role!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647736/16217413a8838de5a89a6245cc4bb5bef7f1a99b.gif[/img]

If you are interested in our game, please add it to your wish list,
This will be very helpful to us, thank you very much!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647736/9283985fb33d20316ff0e8089ba26c8065c07c7b.gif[/img]
